name: tpc-bench
description: One-sentence TPC-H / TPC-DS performance runs for HashData Lightning / Cloudberry (single or multi host, unattended overnight): deploys a CI build, runs proteus (pipeline on/off, N rounds, N concurrent streams), samples per-query resources, compares with the last run, triages the slowest queries with vec-perf-triage, and writes HTML / Markdown reports.
